name: @alitycs/nextjs
description: Next.js bindings for Alitycs — provider with automatic route-change page views for both routers, plus a server entry for route handlers, server actions, and middleware

scripts.build: bun build src/index.tsx --outfile=dist/index.esm.js --target=browser --format=esm --banner "'use client';" --external @alitycs/core --external @alitycs/browser --external @alitycs/react --external next --external react --external react-dom
scripts.build:cjs: bun build src/index.tsx --outfile=dist/index.js --target=node --format=cjs --banner "'use client';" --external @alitycs/core --external @alitycs/browser --external @alitycs/react --external next --external react --external react-dom
scripts.build:server: bun build src/server.ts --outfile=dist/server.esm.js --target=node --format=esm --external @alitycs/core --external next --external react --external react-dom && bun build src/server.ts --outfile=dist/server.js --target=node --format=cjs --external @alitycs/core --external next --external react --external react-dom
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run build:cjs && bun run build:server && bun run build:types
